| worst_mdd | -9.3% | -11.2% | Champion ✓ |

**Champion holds** — the `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` candidate passed validation but didn't dethrone the champion due to:
- Significantly worse tuning minimum (0.05 vs 0.43) indicating fragility

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Notes for Next Session

- Queue is clear (no INCONCLUSIVE candidates)
- Champion v5 is stable at ~9.3% max drawdown
- With 9.5 hours remaining, expect ~60 more iterations
- Focus area: candidates that improve lockbox_min while maintaining MDD ≤ 9.3%
